facts.text: I need a sample meeting transcript like Microsoft Teams for a project start.
The sample meeting should include one technical person responsible, one business person responsible, and one third party responsible for developing.
The meeting is about a proposal sent to the third party regarding creating a website for the business responsible.
The technical person’s goal is to ensure the meeting goes well and helps the business user capture all the details.
I want a summary of the sample meeting in bullet points.
I want next actions mapped on the meeting.
I want a final conclusion for the sample meeting.
I am working with a sample transcript.
My idea is to use the intelligence from the sample transcript to create summaries for my own future meetings.
